agentToml.code:
[agents.legal-review]
name = "legal-review"
[[agents.legal-review.providers]]
id = "anthropic"
model = "claude/sonnet-4-5"
key = "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
[memory]
enabled = true
org = "legal-review"
models = "./models"
data = "./data"

watcherYaml.code:
watchers:
  - slug: contract-review-tracker
    agent: legal-review
    schedule: 0 8 * * 1-5
    prompt: "Review active contracts for approaching deadlines, unsigned agreements, and unresolved risk items. Flag any clauses that still need counsel approval."
    extraction_schema:
      type: object
      required: [pending_contracts, unresolved_risks, approaching_deadlines]
